name: REF2 machine: model27's second reference machine, a triangle and noise through the stock chain
description: The template for a machine that uses everything the standard lets a machine use (notes/63). REF's contract with a triangle in place of REF's parabola (B4a); a shortcut, RETRIG + COLOR = Octave, -2 to +2, saved with the sound by the builder's shortcut layer (B4b); its own main screen label and knob view (B4c), and a tick that blinks the label's dot and a browser hook that shows the name of a file opened on its track (B4d), through the builder's dispatchers when SAMPLE takes the same points. Never offered to users.

uses.why: the note's octave, -2 to +2: k 28, which the voice reads at p + 0x38; the shortcut layer saves it
MainScreenView's draw method: the stock screen, then OCT and the Octave in its free band on a REF2 track
the knob view's draw method: the Octave as five boxes while RETRIG + COLOR turns it on a REF2 track
the screen's redraw, about 30 Hz: counts the ticks, and the label's dot blinks with them
the browser reads the file it opens: on a REF2 track the label shows its name, then the stock open reads it

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_compose.py, tools/emu/test_shortcuts.py and tools/emu/test_views.py (Unicorn, the OS's own code, notes/63 §10, §11.4, §12.4 and §13.4)
emulation.build: alone, as machine 6 or 7 next to sampler, and as machine 8 of sampler, refmachine, refmachine2
